Walks PATH and fixed su paths (/system, /sbin, /debug_ramdisk), distinguishing EACCES from ENOENT.
Checks whether /data/adb, /sbin/.magisk, /debug_ramdisk and Magisk module files are visible.
Reads module.prop under /data/adb/modules to identify module directories and identities.
Probes the EACCES error codes of /data/adb and ap/ksu, and checks KernelSU/APatch manager packages.
Looks for Shamiko traces in /debug_ramdisk/shamiko, /data/adb modules, mountinfo and unix sockets.
Scans /proc/self/maps, the linker solist and LD_PRELOAD for libzygisk / zygisk injection.
Checks /system/xposed.prop, XposedBridge.jar, LSPHooker and LSPosed module paths.
Checks the /data/misc/riru module directory and riru-related mappings.
Checks /data/adb/lspd and the zygisk_lsposed module path.
Scans maps for frida/gadget/linjector, /proc/net/unix, thread names and port 27042.
Reads TracerPid from /proc/self/status and compares it with the :iso snapshot.
Compares /proc/self/maps with /proc/self/map_files entry by entry to find hidden .so mappings.
Parses mountinfo for magisk/KSU/APatch/lspd and data-backed overlay mounts.
Reads /proc/self/attr/current and /sys/fs/selinux/enforce to check the domain and Enforcing state.
Checks ro.kernel.qemu, goldfish/ranchu properties, /dev/qemu_pipe and cloud-phone files.
Reads verifiedbootstate / vbmeta.device_state / flash.locked to judge unlock and verification state.
Reads ro.build.tags and ro.build.type to spot test-keys / userdebug builds.
Reads ro.debuggable, ro.secure and init.svc.adbd.
Compares the executable segments of libc/libart/linker64 against their files to detect inline hooks.
Walks executable mappings and flags anything outside the system/apex/data-app allowlist.
Compares the stat device numbers of the app sandbox with mountinfo to detect stat/mount spoofing.
Cross-checks ro.build.*, ro.system.*, vbmeta, serial and property-area consistency.
Reads the property-area serial and its length to spot resetprop residue.
Compares fingerprint, tags, kernel version and dirty/1970/Toybox markers.
Cross-checks CLOCK_BOOTTIME, /proc/uptime and /proc/stat btime.
Compares getpid/getppid/uid with NSpid/PPid from /proc/self/status and stat.
Cross-checks PR_GET_SECCOMP with the Seccomp field in /proc/self/status.
Generates an AndroidKeyStore key and parses the Key Attestation chain and TEE state.
Checks whether the attestation root is AOSP/software attestation.
Checks the certificate chain length and root to spot keybox replacement or short chains.
Compares su/module/SELinux snapshots between the main process and :iso.
Checks /data/adb/modules/zygisk_assistant and Zygisk-Assistant files.
Checks /data/adb/kpm/cherish_peekaboo.kpm and related module directories.
Checks zygisk-detach / ksu_susfs modules and umount traces in mountinfo.
Checks /data/adb/lspd/dex2oat and lspd dex2oat mounts in mountinfo/maps.
Collects the Build fingerprint and CPU information as the report baseline.
Reads ro.crypto.state / ro.crypto.type and checks the /data mount options.
Compares dalvik.vm.heapsize, heapgrowthlimit and dex2oat-filter for anomalies.
Reads /system/etc/init/hw/init.rc for magisk/resetprop/insmod injection markers.
Checks whether the SELinux policy exists, plus policyvers and the system_file label.
Walks /proc/*/cmdline and ps for su/magisk/ksud/apatch processes.
Counts zygote processes and looks for extra self-spawned zygotes.
Tries to read the zygote maps for xposed/zygisk/riru/frida mappings.
Checks notification listeners, overlays and third-party notification-policy access.
Enumerates this package\'s activities/services and compares them with the declared graph.
Uses local Key Attestation to judge boot state (falls back to local when no server is configured).
Reads /sys/fs/selinux/policy, policyvers and checkreqprot.
Hits when a root manager is present but no Shamiko hiding module can be found.
Checks whether verifiedbootstate=green contradicts locked=0 or an empty digest.
Enumerates packages for rvx/revanced/microg related modules.
Enumerates packages and processes containing inject/zygisk/xposed/lsposed.
Checks whether this process is injected by Zygisk/LSPosed to judge the exclusion list.
Tries to read /data/tombstones and /data/anr for crash/injection traces.
Compares getuid(), the Uid/appid in /proc/self/status and the :iso uid to detect UID hiding.
Repeats the unknown_exec check inside :iso to find executable mappings the main process cannot see.
Reads init.svc.apexd, apexd.status and CLOCK_BOOTTIME to check the APEX start time.
Reads /proc/version and uname to check release/version consistency with libc and the kernel.
Compares the Build fingerprint, brand/model and vbmeta/kernel identity to detect ROM spoofing.
Reads verifiedbootstate, vbmeta.device_state and flash.locked to judge unlock/verification state.
Checks ro.boot.flash.locked, vbmeta.device_state and the TEE unlock state.
Cross-checks Build fields, vbmeta, serial and kernel identity for contradictions.
Checks user CAs, the network security config and trust anchors.
Enumerates common root/framework manager packages to see if KSU/APatch/Magisk managers are installed.
Compares TracerPid between the main process and :iso.
Reads enabled_notification_listeners from Settings.Secure for third-party listeners.
Reads enabled_accessibility_services from Settings.Secure.
Reads Settings.Global.ADB_ENABLED.
Reads Settings.Global.DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED.
Reads the AppOps mock_location grant.
Uses ConnectivityManager to inspect the active transport and VPN networks.
Checks the current uid/user directory to see if this is a work profile or secondary user.
Cross-enumerates with getInstalledPackages, queryIntentActivities and pm list packages.
Checks the launcher xposedminversion meta-data and reflects on the XposedBridge class.
Path probes + /data/adb error codes + mountinfo device numbers.
maps, linker solist, unix sockets, thread names and module paths.
